environment.description: ECS Fargate task deployed in subnet-0xd4e92f (us-east-1a) which is associated with route table rtb-0x7bc31a. The route table contains only local VPC routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint route for com.amazonaws.us-east-1.sqs (vpce-0x9a2f1c, prefix list pl-63a5400a). No NAT gateway, no internet gateway route, no transit gateway attachment. The subnet's network ACL (acl-0x5e8d2a) has explicit deny rules on outbound for 0.0.0.0/0 except the SQS VPC endpoint CIDR range. Security group sg-0x2f9a1b allows egress only to the VPC endpoint prefix list on port 443. DNS resolution is handled by Route 53 Resolver inbound endpoint within the VPC. The SQS VPC endpoint has a policy restricting actions to the specific queue ARN only.

config.nacl_outbound: acl-0x5e8d2a: DENY 0.0.0.0/0 except SQS VPCE CIDR on 443
